| **Date** | `string` (ISO 8601) | `string` (ISO 8601) |

info.description:
## Introduction

Welcome to the Plaky API. Built on REST principles, this API allows you to integrate Plaky into your own app, by using
the endpoints below. If you're looking to integrate operations over board items (list/preview, create new, update an
existing one,
leave a comment and reaction, reply etc.) or get board details, you are in the right place.

A prerequisite for using the public API is to set an API key – in order to authenticate. You can follow [this](https://plaky.com/help/integrations/api/manage-api-keys-in-plaky/) page to find out how to set it up.

## API endpoints usage

All the endpoints are prefixed with the public API URL:
https://api.plaky.com/v1/public.

For example, the endpoint to retrieve item details looks as follows:
https://api.plaky.com/v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}, where you'll replace IDs in curly braces with your actual space/board/item IDs.

## Authentication

To ensure the security of your data, all API requests must be authenticated. We use API keys to identify the caller.

* It's mandatory to include the X-API-Key header with the value of your API key in every request.
* The API key is only visible to you and should NOT be shared publicly.
* By using this API, only operations within the scope of your workspace, user role and permissions are allowed.

For more details on how to manage API keys, you can go to [this](https://plaky.com/help/integrations/api/manage-api-keys-in-plaky/) page.

## Rate limiter

We enforce a rate limit on all API requests in order to maintain high availability and fair usage for all users.
The limitation is 200 requests per user per minute. Exceeding this limit will result in error 429 -
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.

## Pagination

Our REST API supports pagination for all synchronous GET endpoints that retrieve lists of entities. When an endpoint accepts the **page** and **pageSize** query parameters, it will return a paginated response.

To control the data returned in a paginated request, you can use the following optional query parameters:

* **page** (integer): The page number you wish to retrieve. This is **1-indexed**. If this parameter is omitted, the API will default to the first page (**page=1**).
* **pageSize** (integer): The number of items to include on each page. If this parameter is omitted, a default page size will be used.

### Determining if More Data Exists

Every response from an endpoint that supports these parameters will include a **hasMore** field. This boolean flag provides a simple way to determine if you have reached the end of the data set.

* **true**: Additional pages can be fetched.
* **false**: The current page is the final page; no more data is available.

remove item groups.
tags.name: Item Groups

tags.description:
This is a set of endpoints to manage board items. Items could form individual,
highly customizable tasks which could be managed. So, you can create items,
edit/remove also or you can change your custom item field values.
tags.name: Items

tags.description:
Set of endpoints for comment management. You can create specific comment
or reply to the existing one, change/remove as well.
tags.name: Item comments

tags.description:
This is a set of endpoints to manage item comment reaction(s). As a user,
you can set multiple reactions on some comment, override/remove them at
the same time.
tags.name: Item comment reactions

tags.description:
This is a set of endpoints to manage item files. You can upload files,
list them and get download links.
tags.name: Item files
